output.explanation: NIG-US invoiced NIG-AE USD 16,800.00 for the T. Nasser secondment (NIG-US:4471084, INV-US-100411, P-24088). NIG-AE booked the identical amount with reference 100411 one day later (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031287), but against counterparty 'NorthStar Infrastruktur GmbH' (NIG-DE) instead of NIG-US. Amount, currency, invoice reference and project all match with zero difference, so the only error is the partner coding.
output.recommended_action: NIG-AE should reclass the IC payable on ICV-AE-031287 from intercompany partner NIG-DE to NIG-US and confirm the vendor master mapping, so no similar miscoding recurs.
output.adjustment_description: In NIG-AE: debit IC payable – NIG-DE USD 16,800.00 and credit IC payable – NIG-US USD 16,800.00 (reclass of secondment invoice INV-US-100411).
